component.name: MCU Harness Studio
component.summary: Commercial-grade embedded MCU debugging and firmware AI agent harness
商业级嵌入式 MCU 闭环调试与固件开发 AI 工作台

description.p: MCU Harness Studio unifies multi-provider AI coding and debugging workflows with direct, non-halting hardware introspection over J-Link and OpenOCD, CMSIS-SVD bitfield decoding, SEGGER RTT and POSIX UART log streaming, DWARF Live Watch, RTOS stack inspection, and an unbypassable Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) hardware safety interlock.

screenshot.caption: Agent workbench with hardware telemetry and safety interlock

description.p: Initial commercial release of MCU Harness Studio on Qt 6 QML and C++20.
